title: Improving Information Extraction with Learned Queries
abstract: arXiv:2608.31058v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When information extraction fails, a natural instinct is to improve the model doing it: for example, by scaling it up or refining its reasoning. In this paper, we show that another part of the pipeline matters at least as much: the queries used to elicit this information. Across four clinical benchmarks and five LLMs, improving the question design alone raises performance by 18.6 F1-score points, i.e. more than using larger extraction models. To make such question design learnable, we introduce List of Questions (LoQ), which generates document-specific question sets, and FeedQ, a feedback-driven optimization method that iteratively refines questions against extraction outcomes. The resulting optimized questions can be used to train lightweight generators: with fine-tuning, 4B-parameter models match or outperform expert-derived baselines and substantially exceed the performance of much larger untuned models. We release a dataset of 12,820

translated_title: 通过学习到的查询改进信息抽取
translated_abstract: 当信息抽取失败时，人们的第一反应通常是改进执行该任务的模型，例如扩大模型规模或优化其推理能力。本文表明，流水线中的另一个环节同样重要：用于引出信息的查询（问题）。在四个临床基准和五个大语言模型上的实验显示，仅改进问题设计就能将性能提升18.6个F1分数点，超过使用更大抽取模型所带来的收益。为使问题设计可学习，作者提出了List of Questions（LoQ），可针对具体文档生成问题集合；以及FeedQ，一种基于反馈的优化方法，可根据抽取结果迭代地改进问题。优化后的问题还可用于训练轻量级生成器：经过微调，40亿参数的模型即可达到或超越专家设计的问题基线，并大幅超过规模更大的未微调模型。作者还发布了包含12,820条问题的数据集。
tldr: 本文提出LoQ与FeedQ方法，通过自动生成并基于反馈迭代优化面向文档的抽取问题，仅凭改进问题设计即可在临床基准上带来18.6个F1点的提升，超过使用更大模型的效果，并使微调后的40亿参数模型达到甚至超越专家设计的基线。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LoQ and FeedQ, which automatically generate and iteratively optimize document-specific extraction questions via feedback, showing that improved question design alone yields an 18.6 F1-point gain across clinical benchmarks—outperforming larger models—and enables fine-tuned 4B-parameter models to match or exceed expert-derived baselines.
